title: Why we built Launchly
description: Plenty of good local businesses don't have a website — not because they don't want one, but because the usual path there is too slow. Here's what we built instead.

title: What a local business website actually needs
description: Not every business needs the same website. Here's what actually matters — for a trade, a cafe, a gym, or a shop — and what doesn't.

title: What should an electrician's website include?
description: Photos of finished work, the specific jobs you take on, your actual coverage area, and your certifications — what actually gets an electrician's website to convert.

title: Does my cafe or restaurant need a website?
description: If your menu changes often or your hours aren't fixed, a proper website does one job that Instagram and Google Maps don't — here's the honest case for one.

title: What makes people book a gym or studio from its website
description: Visible class times and pricing, real photos of the space, and one obvious first step — what turns a visitor into a trial booking.

title: Google Business Profile vs a website: do you need both?
description: A Business Profile is how people find you. A website is how they decide. Most local businesses genuinely need both, not one instead of the other.

title: What shop and boutique websites get wrong
description: Retail is a visual category. Here's why too much text, generic photos, and vague product descriptions cost small shops and boutiques visits.
